next.reason: 1985: 'The INVALID KEY and the NOT INVALID KEY phrases must be specified if an applicable USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION procedure is not specified'; 2023: 'GR-14.9.35.4-19: "the optional INVALID KEY and NOT INVALID KEY phrases"; GR-9.1.14-4: if not specified and no exception processing, control goes to end'. 2023 no longer requires the phrases when no USE procedure applies. It calls them optional and defines the result, so a REWRITE that 1985 refused is now accepted.
